name: std::swap(std::basic_stringstream)
intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::basic_stringstream. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 streams whose state to swap

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Use an in-memory stream holding 42, then move and swap its state.
